notes: DOCUMENT-INSUFFICIENCY TEST CASE - same situation as the PruShield pair. PruExtra is a CoPay rider attached to the corresponding PruShield plan (reduces the policyholder's co-payment share on hospital bills); only the renewal certificate is available, no policy booklet. sum_assured_sgd is null - CoPay riders have no sum assured concept at all, not even a notional one (unlike PruShield's main hospitalisation benefit, which at least has panel limits in its booklet). exclusions and coverage_gaps null/empty because unavailable from source, not assessed as zero. annual_premium_sgd converted from the certificate's monthly figure (68.00 x 12 = 816.00).
